# Meadowvale at Cedar Ridge

> Meadowvale at Cedar Ridge is an 84-apartment senior living community on Harmony Road in Fort Collins, Colorado, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care and respite stays, licensed by the Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment as assisted living residence ALR-2189.

## Key facts

- Phone: +1-970-555-0163
- Address: 2450 Harmony Road, Fort Collins, CO, 80528
- Hours: Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri 08:00 to 18:00; Sat/Sun 09:00 to 16:00
- Areas served: Fort Collins, CO, Loveland, CO, Windsor, CO, Timnath, CO, Wellington, CO, Greeley, CO
- Services: Independent living, Assisted living, Memory care at The Bridges, Respite stay
- Rating: 4.8 from 96 reviews
